rules.title: CORI requested only as final step in application (market rate housing)
rules.requirement: Landlords, property management companies and real estate agents may request standard access CORI on a market-rate housing applicant only as the final step in the application process, and may not use it to screen other household members or buyers/sellers.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords, property management companies, and real estate agents requesting CORI on applicants for market rate housing.
rules.quoted_span: CORI shall only be requested for a housing applicant as the final step in the application process.
rules.ambiguity_note: Document footer dated 6/11/21; effective date not explicitly stated.

rules.title: CORI final-step requirement for subsidized housing
rules.requirement: Public housing authorities and property management companies administering subsidized housing may request CORI only as the final step in the application process and must screen only as provided by state and federal law.
rules.coverage_text: Public housing authorities and property management companies administering subsidized housing programs.
rules.quoted_span: Public housing authorities and property management companies that administer a subsidized housing program for qualifying subsidized housing units shall screen housing applicants for subsidized housing only as provided by state and federal law. CORI shall only be requested for a housing applicant as the final step in the application process.
rules.ambiguity_note: Document footer dated 6/11/21; effective date not explicitly stated.

rules.title: Disclosure of criminal history before questioning or adverse decision
rules.requirement: Landlords, property management companies, real estate agents and public housing authorities must give the applicant a copy of CORI or other criminal history and disclose its source before asking any questions about it and before making an adverse housing decision based on it.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords, property management companies, real estate agents, and public housing authorities screening housing applicants.
rules.quoted_span:
(a) before asking the applicant any questions about the criminal history; and
(b) before making an adverse housing decision based on the housing applicant's CORI or
other criminal history information.
rules.ambiguity_note: Document footer dated 6/11/21; effective date not explicitly stated.

rules.title: Limits on use of CORI to evaluate market-rate and subsidized applicants
rules.requirement: CORI obtained for market-rate housing may be used solely to decide whether to rent or lease to the applicant; CORI obtained for subsidized housing may be used solely to decide qualification for a subsidized program. It may not otherwise be disseminated.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords, property management companies, real estate agents, and public housing authorities.
rules.quoted_span:
CORI accessed pursuant to 803 CMR 5.04 by a landlord, property management company,
or real estate agent shall be used solely for determining whether torent or lease real property to
the housing applicant.
rules.ambiguity_note: Document footer dated 6/11/21; effective date not explicitly stated.

rules.title: Pre-adverse action procedures for CORI-based housing decisions
rules.requirement: Before adverse action based on CORI or criminal history, a landlord, property management company or real estate agent must notify the applicant, provide a copy of the record and source, CORI policy, identify the basis, allow dispute of accuracy, provide DCJIS correction information, and document compliance. Subsidized housing providers have similar duties including appeal information.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords, property management companies, real estate agents, public housing authorities taking adverse action based on criminal history.
rules.quoted_span:

rules.ambiguity_note: Document footer dated 6/11/21; effective date not explicitly stated.

rules.title: Requirements for using a consumer reporting agency for CORI
rules.requirement: Before a CRA requests CORI for a housing entity, the entity must register with iCORI, give a separate written notice that a consumer report may be used, obtain separate written authorization, obtain a signed CORI Acknowledgment Form, and certify FCRA compliance to the CRA.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords, property management companies, real estate agents, and public housing authorities using a CRA.
rules.ambiguity_note: Document footer dated 6/11/21; effective date not explicitly stated.
